posts.name: dlott1988
posts.cooked:
In celebration of my favorite board/card game, I have a new video series that introduces players to the Sentinels of the Multiverse characters.

 

Who is it for?  

  • Folks who are new to the Sentinels of the Multiverse

  • Die hard SotM fans that want to correct the various minute mistakes a YouTuber/fellow fan makes

  • Anyone who is interested in learning more about the multitude of Sentinels characters. 

 

What are you doing still reading this, go take a look!  :slightly_smiling_face:

Oh yeah, here's the links...

Freedom Five: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tY7ZFcsfOOU

Prime Wardens: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HAq_KpYEsNU

Dark Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F4j2MyCebog

1st 5 Independents: http://youtu.be/yVZN46f58Sk

Heroes Finale: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9q9sHqt-prY

Corrections to the Heroes Videos: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e7IYLPZIPwY

 

Villains

Core Set: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nW1bBCG7Lpw

Rook City: http://youtu.be/CDtJ-2n-YHs

Infernal Relics: http://youtu.be/jlaA3MCQS4Y

Shattered Timelines: http://youtu.be/Ed44MBGq-8c

Vengeance: http://youtu.be/8xip4n69fI4

 

Any feedback is welcome and encouraged. 

I will be making videos about all the heroes, every villain, and each environment.

posts.cooked:
Matchstickman:

The video was fun and engaging as before (and I never even looked a CC's moustache!)… but I'm going to point out that Argent Adept does not need Instruments to play Songs, his base power is called Vocalize for a reason!

 

Argeent Adept's vocalize power is very strong, in the early games/as a last resort. But, AA's at his full strength when he has the whole Link's Awakening ensemble assembled and he's blasting out his best accompaniments and performs.
